name: s7-models
description: Sprint 7 review round 4 (R1-F3, R3-F4): the two model phases only. models (bright, outdoor) and models-dim (static interior) show the repaired Nalfeshnee and Salamander beside their pinned pre-Sprint-7 exports after a natural appearance; each state's gameplay-distance party view is bound to the enabled body renderer and judged in the verdict (image written, lit, in frame, fade cleared, enabled body renderer with its current mesh, intact); whole-body views record sampled body rays and are context only. The bright phase also runs the observer rollback checks, including a failed normal trace disposal. UI and Ghaele phases are not rerun (their dependencies are unchanged). No other mods.
